goal: Run tests on FreeBSD natively in per-PR CI
Catch BSD-specific regressions before they reach master instead of relying on external nightly runs
agreement: Substantive support for running tests on at least one BSD target in Core CI (hebasto, fanquake, pinheadmz)
Preferred over dealing with reactive fixes from noisy nightly failures (fanquake, pinheadmz)
Concerns about nested VM brittleness resolved by agreeing to a trial run (maflcko)
Open review questions on CI script details and filesystem choices (maflcko, hebasto)
Concept approval without stated reasons (vasild, winterrdog)
